<!--
Covers the parts of `apa-note` that have broken most often, in the formats
that have no other fixture here.

A successful run produces, in every format:

  - Panel labels reading "Panel A" and "Panel B", not quarto's "(A)" and not
    an unlabelled panel;
  - each panel's caption above its panel, never below it;
  - each panel's own note under that panel, printed once;
  - the note of the whole figure under the grid, printed once;
  - a note under the table;
  - a reference to a panel that resolves, reading "Figure 1B" rather than a
    figure number of its own or a dangling link.

The panels carry labels of their own, which is the case that used to leave
each one in a figure environment or grid cell of its own and stack them.
-->

# Discussion

Text after the float, so that the spacing which follows a figure with a note
has something to apply to [@schneiderCattellHornCarrollTheoryCognitive2018].
